mapping.draft_py:
# Cryptic Caves. Kept: "{T}: Add {C}." (compiler, abilities[0]).
# 2. "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card." -- Silversmote Ghoul's B5c-cost-b-sacrifice-draw
#    with Fabled Passage's {T} and a generic {1}.
# 3. "Activate only if you control five or more lands." -- the activation gate rides on the ability's
#    condition, as Celestial Enforcer's B5a-activate-only-flying, CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 5 over lands.
draw = ActivatedAbility(
    cost=Cost(parts=(
        CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),
        CostSacrifice(target=Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAnd(children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            )),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        )),
        CostTap(),
    )),
    effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
        count=QConst(value=5),
        inner_filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land'),
    ),
)
abilities = [*compiled, draw]
